# vendor/

Place the verified contract sources here before running `npm run extract` (M1):

- `src/**` — AscendLaunchpad.sol, AscendToken.sol, ListingDesk.sol, yield satellites, interfaces, libraries (extracted from the Elysium testnet explorer contract tab; MIT).
- `lib/` — dependencies as imported: `infinity-core/**` (PancakeSwap, GPL/MIT as marked), solmate, OpenZeppelin.

Do not edit vendored files; they are pinned inputs to the extraction.
